case.title: CPCL undersea crude pipeline leak off Pattinacherry, Nagapattinam

incident.timeNote: March 2023; exact day not confirmed in public sources

oil.spilledNote: NGT noted CPCL failed to account for 1,200 litres of leaked oil.

facilities.name: CPCL CBR UNDERSEA CRUDE PIPELINE
facilities.note: Crack in 9 km undersea pipeline from Cauvery Basin Refinery used to transfer crude to ships
facilities.source: NGT order as reported by Khan Global Studies

observations.description: Crude oil leak off Pattinacherry coast

timeline.event: Crude leak from undersea pipeline off Pattinacherry (March 2023)
NGT fines CPCL Rs 5 crore under no-fault liability (reported 2025)

case.officialFindings: Crack in 9 km undersea pipeline. NGT fined CPCL Rs 5 crore applying no-fault liability despite external cause.

sources.title: Nagapattinam oil spill: NGT fines CPCL (Khan Global Studies)
